name: abecoffman/affiliate-link-manager-integration-tests
description: Isolated Composer context for the integration test tier. Kept separate from the plugin's own root composer.json deliberately: WordPress core's own PHPUnit test library still calls a PHPUnit\Util\Test method PHPUnit 10 removed (confirmed even on trunk), so WP_UnitTestCase-based tests require PHPUnit 9.6 specifically -- pinning the *root* composer.json to 9.6 would silently drop this project's deliberate PHP 8.3/PHPUnit 10 CI coverage for the unit tier. This context only ever runs locally, never in CI, so it can stay pinned to whatever WP core's test library actually needs. See webp-generator's identical tests/integration/composer.json, where this pattern was first established.
